facts.fact: Phil 把购物袋放到 Hamish 脚边，独自进酒馆查看情况。
facts.anchor: put down her bags at his feet

facts.fact: Phil 把 Faith 单独派去后停车场，查看 Miss Worth 的车是否完好，并交代不要试图开走。
facts.anchor: Faith, I want you to sneak round to the car park at the back

facts.fact: Faith 把 Jane 的车热接线（hot-wire）启动，自己没有开走。
facts.anchor: she was the one who’d done the hot-wiring

facts.fact: Phil 在酒馆外用手机打给 Jane，让她假装闲聊回答，同时确认她是否有人身危险。
facts.anchor: The phone rang twice, three times

facts.fact: Phil 把有机猫砂堆在酒馆后门点燃，用浓烟制造火警，把酒馆里的人逼到街上。
facts.anchor: you pile it at the back entrance and set light to it

facts.fact: Jane 从手套箱取出一把短管左轮手枪，向车外的豹形 demon 连开数枪。
facts.anchor: pulled out what looked like a remarkably well cared for snub-nosed revolver

facts.fact: Phil 命女生们摇下车窗，把土豆（后改用萝卜）扔向追车的豹。
facts.anchor: Lower the windows and throw potatoes at it

facts.fact: Phil 踩死刹车让车尾甩出、车身横滑，Flauros 冲过路口后才刹住掉头。
The Head 坐在校门口的野餐伞下做填字游戏，让女生们把买的土豆立刻送进厨房。
facts.anchor: Girls, you are to take your purchases to the kitchen

facts.fact: Jane Worth 是学校的数学老师，只想不被打扰地教自己的科目。
facts.anchor: a simple maths teacher who just wanted to be left alone

facts.fact: The Head 拿 Jane 可能藏有的秘密（含黑客与赌博）向她施压/勒索。
facts.anchor: which the Head was apparently blackmailing her with

facts.fact: Hamish 自称参与了一项针对 Grayne's 学校的调查（Phil 追问他隶属警方还是特勤部门）。
facts.anchor: part of an investigation into Grayne

facts.fact: 车后座那四个女生是 Grayne's 的 junior 学生，也是 Phil 的学生；Jane 用“回去赶 prep”来管她们。
facts.anchor: the four juniors wriggling around in the back seat

facts.fact: 坐在 Jane 桌子两边的是两个男人（Phil 一方听到的数目）。
夜间湿滑的 moor 路上，车速已超过 80 英里/小时。
facts.anchor: over eighty miles an hour by night on a wet road

facts.fact: 脱险后 Phil 把车速压到限速以下五英里。
facts.anchor: virtuous five miles below the speed limit

facts.fact: Jane 的手枪连震三次（once, twice, a third time），即开出三枪。
